module_summary: dash_tools.c is the dashboard Tools tab: a static table of tools dispatched through dashRunMisc or native screens, plus the MMCE backup status worker job, the OPL IGR helper setup, the GitHub self-update check (release JSON parsing, commit ancestry compare, worker-run install), the Google Drive link/sync/browse/recover menus (ETH && WLE_NATIVE_CLOUD) and a USB unit diagnostic. dash_ui.c holds the shared dashboard widgets: pad input mapping and repeat logic, button glyphs and the sorted footer hint bar, header tabs and clock, panels/selection/glow primitives, toasts, the modal menu/choice/confirm/message dialogs, and the loading overlay with file-progress and storage-probe hooks used by classic filer code and the worker.

reusable_helpers.what: modal list menu with icons, details, disabled rows, optional marks/edit/preview callbacks

findings.title: releaseJsonString and the asset size parse re-implement cloud_google.c json_string/json_int
findings.problem: dash_tools.c releaseJsonString (needle "key", strstr, skip to ':', whitespace, quoted value copy) is the same algorithm as the static json_string in cloud_google.c, which also handles escapes; the inline "size" parse in releaseAssetDigest (skip spaces and ':' then atoi) is json_int's body. Both files are linked into the same ELF and the dash_tools.c code is only built with ETH && WLE_NATIVE_CLOUD, where cloud_google.c is also compiled.
findings.fix: Make cloud_google.c json_string (and json_int) non-static with a prototype in cloud_google.h, delete releaseJsonString and call the shared one; replace the inline size parse with json_int on the asset slice. Results are equivalent for the fields used (status, target_commitish, digest, name), which are then validated anyway.
findings.benefit: ~33 source lines removed and one copy of the parser in .text (a few hundred bytes, INFERRED from the 31-line function at -Os)
findings.evidence: Read dash_tools.c:715-790 and cloud_google.c:61-121. Grep for the needle pattern snprintf(needle,...,"\"%s\"") over src/: only cloud_google.c:69,113 and dash_tools.c:723. ps2.yaml:506 compiles src/cloud_google.c unconditionally (no file-level #if; only WLE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID blocks at :207,238). releaseJsonString callers: dash_tools.c:760,772,864,968. Empty-string difference (releaseJsonString rejects n<=0) is covered by later checks: updateIsCommitId, strncmp sha256:, unknown status.

findings.title: dashOkLabelKey and dashDrawFocusFrame are never called
findings.problem: The only matches for dashOkLabelKey and dashDrawFocusFrame in the whole repo (src, include, tests, docs) are their definitions in dash_ui.c and their prototypes in dash_internal.h.
findings.fix: Delete both functions and both prototypes.
findings.benefit: ~29 lines removed; no ELF change: BUILD-EVIDENCE.md lists dashDrawFocusFrame (524 bytes) among --gc-sections discards (MEASURED), dashOkLabelKey is likewise unreferenced
findings.evidence: Grep dashOkLabelKey|dashDrawFocusFrame over src/Launchstation (all file types incl. tests, docs): dash_ui.c:176, dash_ui.c:611, dash_internal.h:884, dash_internal.h:1130 only. evidence/Launchstation/BUILD-EVIDENCE.md:123 lists 'dash_ui.o dashDrawFocusFrame 524' in discarded sections.

findings.title: Five exported dash_ui.c functions only forward to a static twin
findings.problem: dashButtonWidth, dashModalBackdrop, dashModalPanel, dashModalHintRow and dashDrawButton each just call the static buttonWidth, modalBackdrop, modalPanel, modalHintRow and drawButton with the same arguments. Each operation exists under two names.
findings.fix: Remove static from the five originals and give them the public names (or keep the public names and delete the static ones, renaming the in-file calls). Update the source-slicing host tests that look the static names up (tests/test_editor_keyboard.py:240, test_file_operation_overlay.py:63,84, test_modal_animation.py:101, test_hint_bar_fit.py:32-33, test_hint_order.py:36-37, test_pad_icon_order.py:23).
findings.benefit: ~20 source lines removed; ELF effect a few tail-call stubs (tens of bytes, INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read dash_ui.c:231-279, 825-880. External callers exist (dash_widgets.c:426 dashButtonWidth; dashModalPanel/HintRow/Backdrop used in dash_tools.c:277-295 and other dash_*.c), so only the duplication is removed, not the API. Grep of tests/ shows the static names are extracted by several host tests listed in the fix.

findings.title: Cloud history: save-version and card-snapshot recovery are two near-identical blocks
findings.problem: In cloudBrowseHistory the .psu branch (1293-1317) and the .mcd snapshot branch (1318-1340) run the same sequence: dashPickPath folder, dashModalConfirm, dashWorkerAwaitAll, clear buffers, loading begin, call a recover function with the identical (item, folder, result, size, error, size) signature, loading end, success/failure message. Only the strings and the function differ.
findings.fix: Pick the five strings and the recover function pointer (cloudGoogleRecoverSaveVersion or cloudGoogleRecoverSnapshot) from genCmpFileExt(item->name, "PSU") once, then run one copy of the sequence.
findings.benefit: ~18 source lines removed (INFERRED from the two 24-line blocks); small .text reduction
findings.evidence: Read dash_tools.c:1278-1352 line by line; both recover calls at 1306 and 1329 take identical argument lists.

findings.title: Tools table: TA_BROWSER_AT and Tool.path duplicate TA_BROWSER
findings.problem: Tool.path is NULL for every entry except the three TA_BROWSER_AT rows, where it is ""; runTool passes t->path ? t->path : "" to dashOpenBrowser, which is exactly what TA_BROWSER does with dashOpenBrowser(""). The extra action and the field never carry information.
findings.fix: Change the three rows to TA_BROWSER, delete TA_BROWSER_AT, its case and the path member (and the trailing NULL/"" initializer of all 28 rows).
findings.benefit: ~4 lines plus 28 initializers shortened; 112 bytes of .rodata (28 entries x 4-byte pointer, INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read dash_tools.c:37-84 and 1596-1646. Grep TA_BROWSER_AT over the repo: only dash_tools.c:27,56,57,58,1615. t->path is read only at :1616.

findings.title: dashModalMenu resets the one-shot callbacks three times and duplicates the Up/Down skip loop
findings.problem: modal_preview, modal_marks and modal_edit are already copied into locals at 931-934, yet the same three NULL assignments are written out at 946-948, 954-956 and 961-963. The Up and Down handlers are the same do/while skip-disabled loop with the direction flipped.
findings.fix: Clear the three globals once right after copying them (before the early returns) and drop the other two copies; fold Up/Down into one step with d = -1/+1.
findings.evidence: Read dash_ui.c:928-1036. The locals preview/marks/edit/edit_arg are captured at 931-934 before any return, so clearing the globals immediately is equivalent.

findings.title: Unused parameter and return value in dash_ui.c header/clock code
findings.problem: dashDrawHeader takes section_anim and discards it with (void)section_anim; its only caller dash_main.c:1205 passes it. clockText returns 0/1 but both callers (dash_ui.c:473 and :501) ignore the result.
findings.fix: Drop the section_anim parameter (prototype, definition, the one call and the (void) line) and make clockText void. tests/test_files_tab_lifecycle.py:35 asserts the call text and needs the same edit.
findings.evidence: Grep section_anim over src/include/tests: dash_ui.c:520,530 are the only uses inside dashDrawHeader; dashDrawHeader called only at dash_main.c:1205. clockText called only at dash_ui.c:473 and :501, both as statements.

findings.title: dash_tools.c includes mmce_igr.h twice and re-declares dashToolsRefreshMmceStatus
findings.problem: #include "mmce_igr.h" appears on lines 10 and 12; the forward declaration of dashToolsRefreshMmceStatus at 428 repeats the prototype already in dash_internal.h:1031, which the file includes at line 8.
findings.evidence: Read dash_tools.c:1-21 and 428; grep dashToolsRefreshMmceStatus shows the prototype at include/dash_internal.h:1031.
